---
title: "Lecture library"
subtitle: "Every lecture of ES 667 Deep learning, Semester I 2026-27, with its slides, notebooks, cheat sheet and 3-minute summary videos."
---

Each row is one lecture, grouped by part of the course. The slides and notebooks are from
[dl-teaching](https://nipunbatra.github.io/dl-teaching/), which also has the full set of lecture decks. The 3-minute
summaries are also collected, in course order, on the
[Deep learning in 3 minutes](https://nipunbatra.github.io/dl-in-3-minutes.html) page and in a
[YouTube playlist](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLP_52n19dyQM).

[**Slides**: lecture handouts (PDF) · **Present**: the classroom build of the same slides · **Notebooks**: worked
code, most of it runs in Colab · **Cheat sheet**: a two-page A4 review guide (PDF) · **3-min summary**: a short video
on one idea from the lecture; where a lecture has several, point at a letter to see its title · **Recording**: the
full lecture video.]{.res-key}

::: {.lecture-library}
